services.desc: Captain Jared is a native of the Emerald Coast and has been a parasail captain for over five years. Jared's roots are from New England and he is a Patriots and Red Sox Fan. Captain Cole attends the University of Central Florida where he is on the ultimate frisbee team; Cole has been a parasail captain for three years. Cody and Jacob are deckhands; Cody was on the swim team in high school and is like a fish in the water; he falls off the boat on porpoise. In his spare time, Cody treats a video game addiction.
